result.justification: floor is FP32 exactly 1; max and conversion to float preserve >=1; the FP64 scale is filled with that value and CPU binary64 reciprocal of a positive scale >=1 is in [0,1], including a zero reciprocal if float conversion overflows to infinity under standard correctly rounded IEEE semantics. This is an upper bound, not a measurement or reconstruction of the actual inverse weights.
